stories.title: County Group signs JDA for luxury housing project in Noida
stories.summary: County Group has partnered with Elate Realtors to develop a luxury housing project on a 24.71-acre land parcel in Noida. The land is valued at ₹830 crore and was secured through a joint development agreement. The company expects to launch the project in December 2026.

stories.title: County Group acquires 24.71 acres in Noida for ₹830 crore
stories.summary: County Group has acquired a 24.71-acre land parcel in Noida's Sector 150 through a joint development agreement with Elate Realtors. The ₹830 crore transaction was financed by Tata Capital Housing Finance. The developer plans to launch a luxury residential project on the site in December 2026.

stories.title: County Group acquires 24.71 acres in Noida for ₹830 crore
stories.summary: County Group has acquired a 24.71-acre land parcel in Noida's Sector 150 through a joint development agreement with Elate Realtors. The ₹830 crore transaction was financed by Tata Capital Housing Finance. The developer plans to launch a luxury residential project on the site in December 2026.

stories.title: PGA Of America Enters India's Real Estate Market, Chennai To Get Major Golf Community By 2029 - NDTV Sports
Gurugram real estate growth expected from Greater SPR project
stories.summary: The Haryana government is moving forward with land acquisition for the Greater Southern Peripheral Road project. Compensation rates for six villages total approximately ₹986 crore. The infrastructure project is expected to improve connectivity across Gurugram, the Southern Peripheral Road, and the Golf Course Extension Road.

stories.title: GYGY Group acquires two-acre commercial land in Noida
stories.summary: GYGY Group has secured a two-acre site in Noida's Sector 135 via e-auction for ₹135 crore. The company plans a commercial development spanning 6.5 lakh sq ft with a projected gross development value of ₹546 crore. The project will include retail spaces once regulatory approvals are secured.

stories.title: Cityscape India to debut in Mumbai in 2027
stories.summary: Informa Markets will host the first Indian edition of the real estate investment platform Cityscape at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai. The event is scheduled for April 16-18, 2027. The platform aims to tap into the expanding domestic real estate sector.

stories.title: Assetz receives SEBI nod for ₹1,200 crore IPO
stories.summary: Real estate firm Assetz has received final observations from the Securities and Exchange Board of India for its proposed ₹1,200 crore public issue. The company filed preliminary papers in August. JM Financial, BofA Securities India, and Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors are managing the offering.

stories.title: Pending home sales fall to record low
stories.summary: Pending home sales in the U.S. fell 4.7 percent in October from September and 16.7 percent year-over-year, according to the National Association of Realtors. Sales are down 41 percent from September 2019. The decline was most pronounced in the South and West regions.

stories.title: Pending home sales decrease 4.7 percent in October
stories.summary: Pending home sales fell 4.7 percent month-over-month and 16.7 percent year-over-year in October, according to the National Association of Realtors. NAR Chief Economist Lawrence Yun suggested October could be the low point for the cycle as mortgage rates appear to have topped out.

stories.title: Pending home sales tumble to record low
stories.summary: Pending home sales fell 4.7 percent in October and 16.7 percent year-over-year, reaching a new record low. The National Association of Realtors report attributes the decline to mortgage rates reaching a three-year peak. NAR Chief Economist Lawrence Yun suggested the cycle may have reached its trough.

stories.title: US Pending Home Sales Fall to New Record Low on High Rates - Bloomberg.com
Homebuilder sentiment hits 14-year low
stories.summary: A survey by the National Association of Home Builders found confidence in the single-family housing market has fallen to its lowest level since 2012. Builders cited high mortgage rates, increased costs for labor and materials, and low consumer confidence as reasons for the decline.

stories.title: Home builders increase price cuts to attract buyers
stories.summary: A survey by the National Association of Home Builders found 46 percent of builders are reducing prices and 68 percent are offering sales incentives. Builders are attempting to find buyers as demand remains low in the face of 7 percent mortgage rates.

stories.title: Pending home sales fall as mortgage rates peak
stories.summary: Pending home sales fell 4.7 percent in October to a record low, according to the National Association of Realtors. Rates hit a peak of 7.4 percent during the month. Markets currently expect a Federal Reserve rate hike in December as inflation data remains above forecasts.

stories.title: Pending home sales hit record low
stories.summary: Pending home sales fell 4.7 percent in October and 16.7 percent year-over-year, marking a second straight month of record lows. The National Association of Realtors expects 2026 to see the weakest annual existing-home sales since the mid-1990s. The West region experienced the largest decline.

stories.title: Homebuilder confidence hits 14-year low
stories.summary: Homebuilder confidence has dropped to a 14-year low as firms increase price cuts to attract buyers. National Association of Home Builders Chairman Bill Owens cited high mortgage rates, labor shortages, and rising fuel prices as primary challenges currently facing the industry.

stories.title: National office vacancy falls to 17.2% as Class A pulls ahead
stories.summary: CommercialCafe data shows U.S. office vacancy at 17.2%, down 140 basis points year over year. A flight to quality is widening the gap between asset classes, with Class A asking rents rising 2.5% while Class B rents slipped 0.3%. Completions are expected to continue through 2027.

stories.title: Delhi's Khan Market retains 24th spot among world's priciest retail streets
stories.summary: Khan Market has retained its 24th global ranking for expensive retail streets, according to Cushman and Wakefield. Annual rents rose 14 percent to $238 per square foot. The location remains the only Indian site among the top retail streets tracked in the report.

stories.title: The Secret to This Mall’s Success Isn’t Shopping - WSJ
Indeed puts its namesake Austin tower offices up for sublease - Austin American-Statesman
CIP Real Estate sells Dallas-Fort Worth logistics portfolio
stories.summary: CIP Real Estate has sold a three-property industrial portfolio in the Dallas-Fort Worth area to Timber Hill Group. The transaction includes 168,600 square feet of space across 35.3 acres. The properties are more than 90 percent leased to a variety of freight and logistics tenants.

stories.title: Lemoore Chipotle sells for $3.58M, Clovis warehouse changes hands
stories.summary: Commercial real estate transactions in the Central Valley include the sale of a Lemoore Chipotle property for $3.58 million and the transfer of a warehouse in Clovis. Further details regarding the specific terms of these deals were not provided.

stories.title: Upper West Side Broadway storefront vacancies decline
stories.summary: A West Side Rag survey of ground-floor commercial storefronts on Broadway between West 59th and 110th streets counted 71 vacancies at the end of October. This is nine fewer than the 80 vacancies recorded in 2025. There remains more than one empty storefront per block.

stories.title: Premier Development buys former Lord & Taylor site in Westfield - NJBIZ
Beachwood’s La Place, six Shoppes at Parma buildings change hands in separate deals - Crain's Cleveland
Aurionpro wins fresh ₹100 crore AI data centre order
stories.summary: Aurionpro Solutions has secured an additional order worth nearly ₹100 crore from a global hyperscaler for an AI-ready data centre in Southern India. This brings the total value of orders from the customer to over ₹400 crore. The project is scheduled for completion within nine months.

stories.title: Data centre boom to drive 35 million square feet of warehousing demand
stories.summary: India's data centre industry is projected to generate demand for 30 to 35 million square feet of specialised warehousing space by 2030, according to a Savills India report. The growth is attributed to artificial intelligence workloads, cloud adoption, and rising data consumption across the country.

stories.title: Japan's NTT shifts to asset-light data centre strategy
stories.summary: NTT plans to sell existing data centre facilities to a real estate investment trust to reduce debt. The company intends to maintain and operate the centres while using the proceeds to fund new construction. The strategy prioritises debt reduction over the retention of stable income.

stories.title: Triten starts small-bay industrial project in Southwest Houston
stories.summary: Triten Real Estate Partners has broken ground on the Southwest Houston Industrial Center, a 173,000-square-foot speculative development. The project targets small-bay and last-mile businesses, with the developer noting that proximity to residential areas is becoming as important as highway access for modern industrial tenants.

stories.title: Savills Investment Management acquires German logistics property
stories.summary: Savills Investment Management has acquired a logistics property in Wernau, Germany, from developer Logic Green GmbH. The acquisition is part of a European logistics strategy that now includes 22 properties. The purchase price for the 2023-built asset was not disclosed.

stories.title: Cove Capital Investments acquires industrial distribution center
stories.summary: Cove Capital Investments has acquired a 16,573-square-foot industrial distribution centre in Montgomery, Alabama. The asset is 100 percent occupied by a food distribution company. The acquisition was completed as a debt-free transaction for the firm's new Delaware Statutory Trust offering.

stories.title: Warehouse properties in Urbandale sold for $25 million
stories.summary: AM Anderson Properties has sold several warehouse properties in Urbandale for just over $25 million. The transaction includes a 106,700-square-foot flex building valued at $11.3 million and an 18,750-square-foot building valued at $1.6 million. The buyer is a group of local industrial entities.

stories.title: NICDC showcases three industrial nodes in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: The National Industrial Corridor Development Corporation presented the status of three Greenfield Industrial Smart City projects in Andhra Pradesh at the CII Partnership Summit. The projects in Krishnapatnam, Orvakal and Kopparthy cover a combined area of 7,200 acres and are currently under development.

stories.title: Triten breaks ground on Southwest Houston Industrial Center
stories.summary: Triten Real Estate Partners has begun construction on an 18-acre speculative industrial development on Beltway 8. The project will deliver two Class A buildings totaling 172,889 square feet. The area has seen significant warehouse development over the last eight years.

stories.title: Delhi Metro proposes eight new corridors under Phase V(B)
stories.summary: The Delhi Metro has submitted eight proposed corridors for government approval, including a link between Yashobhoomi and Rajiv Chowk. Seven of the routes have received local government clearance and await federal input. The expansion aims to connect densely populated areas, adding 65 stations to the network.

stories.title: Yashobhoomi to Gurugram among eight routes proposed for Delhi Metro
stories.summary: Delhi Metro has proposed eight new corridors under its Phase V(B) expansion, including a link between Yashobhoomi and Rajiv Chowk. Seven routes have secured local government approval and are awaiting federal sign-off. The project aims to improve connectivity for commuters in outer and densely populated areas.

stories.title: Mumbai-Ahmedabad bullet train cost nears ₹2.03 lakh crore
stories.summary: The cost of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad high-speed rail project has nearly doubled to ₹2,02,797 crore from its initial estimate of ₹1.08 lakh crore. As of March 2026, ₹92,761 crore has been spent. Originally targeted for completion by 2023, the project has faced delays due to land acquisition issues.

stories.title: Sreedharan proposes 9-km sky metro for Kochi
stories.summary: Former Delhi Metro chief E Sreedharan has proposed a 9-km suspended pod-based sky metro to link Mattancherry with Ernakulam South. Estimated to cost less than ₹1 billion per kilometre, the system is intended to address rising transport demand. Kochi Metro Rail has been asked to study the technology.

stories.title: Namo Bharat corridor hits 50 million passenger milestone
stories.summary: The Namo Bharat regional rail corridor has recorded 50 million passenger journeys since operations began in October 2023. The latest 10 million journeys were completed in 93 days, with the service averaging over 3.2 million passengers per month during the most recent quarter. Demand remains sustained.

stories.title: Maharashtra Maritime Board selects consultants for water metro
stories.summary: The Maharashtra Maritime Board has appointed project management and environmental consultants for the first phase of the Mumbai Water Metro. A joint venture of Tissa India and RINA Consulting will oversee project management, while Building Environment India will handle environmental services. The project remains in its initial stages.

stories.title: Industry experts discuss future-ready cities in West Bengal
stories.summary: Industry leaders and policymakers at the Viksit West Bengal Summit 2026 stated that the state's urban transformation requires integrating governance, logistics, and technology. Discussions focused on modernising Kolkata and emerging urban centres to improve connectivity and public service delivery through a coordinated development framework for future-ready cities.

stories.title: West Bengal outlines plan for four new North Bengal cities
stories.summary: Urban Development Minister Agnimitra Paul announced plans for four new cities in North Bengal and a long-term development vision for the Kolkata metropolitan region by 2047. The state aims to move beyond basic infrastructure to create investment-friendly urban environments that improve quality of life and generate economic growth.

stories.title: India reports rise in public infrastructure capital expenditure
stories.summary: India's public capital expenditure has increased from approximately ₹2 lakh crore in the 2014-15 fiscal year to ₹12.2 lakh crore in 2026-27. The government attributes this growth to integrated planning across transport, logistics, housing, and water sectors, aimed at strengthening connectivity and supporting sustained national economic expansion.

stories.title: Telangana RERA penalises 17 builders for project violations
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has ordered 17 developers to refund buyers, register plots, and complete promised amenities. The authority also imposed penalties for RERA Act violations. In one case, it rejected a promoter's claim that buyer requests were time-barred, ordering immediate execution of sale deeds.

stories.title: Telangana RERA upholds plot registration rights for BHEL society
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has ruled that 38 members of the Elite BHEL Employees Housing Society are entitled to plot registrations. The authority rejected the promoter's attempt to cancel allotments based on a 2022 deadline, ordering the registration process to proceed upon payment of outstanding dues.

stories.title: Telangana RERA rules in favour of BHEL society members
stories.summary: The Telangana Real Estate Regulatory Authority has ordered the registration of plots for 38 BHEL Employees Housing Society members at Magnus Elite Homes. The authority rejected the promoter's reliance on a 2022 deadline to deny allotments and barred the creation of third-party interests until compliance is met.

stories.title: Telangana RERA fines Sanali IT Parks ₹25 lakh
stories.summary: Telangana RERA has fined Sanali IT Parks ₹25 lakh for marketing units in an unregistered project. The authority declined to order refunds for 13 buyers, noting their payments were directed toward land already registered in their names. The firm must stop all sales until the project is registered.

stories.title: Supreme Court upholds quashing of ₹388 crore housing demand
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has upheld the quashing of a ₹388 crore demand issued by the Uttar Pradesh Avas Evam Vikas Parishad to a developer. The court ruled that the board could not demand payment for replacement land after retaining and developing the developer's more valuable original parcel without compensation.

stories.title: Nigerian government announces N100 million mortgage scheme
stories.summary: The Nigerian government has introduced mortgage loans of up to N100 million at a 9.75% interest rate, repayable over 20 years. Applicants are required to provide a 10% deposit. The initiative is part of a broader effort to address the country's estimated 15 million unit housing deficit.

stories.title: Tinubu launches housing loan scheme for Nigerians
stories.summary: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has announced a mortgage facility offering up to N100 million at a fixed 9.75% interest rate. The scheme, which allows for a 20-year repayment period, is designed to address long-standing difficulties in accessing affordable housing. Over 2,300 citizens across 27 states have already benefited.

stories.title: Nigeria introduces N1 trillion real estate investment fund
stories.summary: President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has announced mortgage loans of up to N100 million for eligible Nigerians, funded through the N1 trillion MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund. The programme offers a 20-year repayment period at a fixed interest rate, aiming to expand access to affordable housing across the country.

stories.title: Nigeria expands housing finance through MOFI fund
stories.summary: The Nigerian government has launched a mortgage programme offering loans of up to N100 million at a 9.75% fixed interest rate. Backed by the MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund, the initiative allows for 20-year repayment terms to improve homeownership accessibility for eligible citizens.

stories.title: India real estate investment inflows rise 39 percent in 9M 2026
stories.summary: India recorded a 39 percent year-on-year increase in real estate investments from January to September 2026, according to Colliers. Hospitality and alternative assets grew six to seven times over the same period last year. Office assets remained the largest category, accounting for 37 percent of total capital deployed.

MetLife closes 370 million dollar commercial real estate debt fund
stories.summary: MetLife Investment Management has closed a 370 million dollar debt fund. The company says the fund will provide capital for transitional commercial real estate opportunities across the United States.

Digital property trials hint at the future of online home sales
stories.summary: Fortune Business Insights expects the global proptech market to grow from 44.59 billion dollars in 2026 to 104.57 billion dollars by 2034. The sector is currently focusing on digitizing property markets to replace traditional paper trails. The future of the industry is being tested in various national trials.

stories.title: RESAAS expands commercial data exchange to include REITs
stories.summary: RESAAS Services has expanded its Commercial Data Exchange platform to include Real Estate Investment Trusts as a new customer segment. The company says this move signifies an important evolution of its platform, extending its reach beyond commercial brokerages and institutional landlords to include the REIT market.

stories.title: Tellus App integrates AI support analyst into Chatwoot
stories.summary: Tellus App integrated its account tools and an in-house AI support analyst into the Chatwoot customer support platform. The company reports that first replies during support hours became 45 percent faster following the integration. Conversation volume grew by approximately 30 percent over the same period.

Magicbricks launches Sustainable Real Estate Index 2026
stories.summary: Magicbricks and the School of Planning and Architecture in Delhi have launched an index to assess the readiness of ten major Indian cities for sustainable development. The index evaluates cities based on six parameters including infrastructure capacity and environmental risk to determine potential for risk-adjusted investment returns.

stories.title: The Agency gains celebrity investor as Weichert adds Google listings
stories.summary: Tony Robbins has invested in a real estate brokerage for the first time. Separately, Weichert, Realtors has joined the HouseCanary-powered Google Listings Program, which will display active listings from company-owned offices in five states directly within mobile search results. The carousel is now a feature of search.

stories.title: HomeServices appoints first chief technology officer
stories.summary: HomeServices of America has created a new C-suite role, appointing Maria Latushkin as its first chief technology officer to lead tech initiatives across its brands. Meanwhile, CoStar has hired a new human resources chief with the stated goal of improving the quality of its sales teams.

stories.title: Construction material prices rise in Cyprus
stories.summary: The Price Index of Construction Materials in Cyprus rose 4.09% in October compared to the same month last year, according to CySTAT. Metallic products led the increases at 6.18%. The index also recorded a 0.39% rise over the previous month. Hardware is supposed to be a constant.

stories.title: Cyprus construction material costs increase
stories.summary: Construction material prices in Cyprus rose 4.09% year on year in October 2026, according to the Statistical Service. Metallic products saw the largest annual increase at 6.18%, followed by wood, insulation, chemicals and plastics at 5.21%. Monthly prices increased by 0.39% from September.

stories.title: Cyprus reports October construction material index
stories.summary: The Price Index of Construction Materials for October 2026 reached 123.90 units, a 4.09% increase over the previous year. Metallic products rose 6.18%, while wood, insulation, chemicals and plastics grew by 5.21%. The index increased 0.39% compared to September. The base year remains 2021.

stories.title: Ecnec approves revised construction material rates
stories.summary: The Executive Committee of the National Economic Council has approved revised rates for government construction projects. The price of coarse sand rose by nearly 86%, while diesel increased by about 24%. Rates for imported stone and 420 MPa steel rods were reduced. The 2022 schedule is being updated.

stories.title: Great Britain publishes aggregate minerals survey
stories.summary: The government has published the 2023 aggregate minerals survey for Great Britain, the first to cover the nation as a whole. The survey aims to provide a current picture of sales, transportation, consumption and permitted reserves of primary aggregates at both national and sub-national levels.

stories.title: NLR expands domestic concrete production research
stories.summary: The National Laboratory of the Rockies is expanding its lab space to support domestic production of cement. Senior researcher John Kevern noted that concrete represents 50% of all human-made materials, describing cement as the flour in the concrete cookie. The facility aims to support modern infrastructure.

stories.title: Carlisle acquires PermaTherm to enter panel market
stories.summary: Carlisle is acquiring PermaTherm to gain access to the North American insulated metal panel market, which the company values at more than $2 billion. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026. PermaTherm operates manufacturing facilities in Georgia.

stories.title: Installed Building Products acquires Take Pride Insulation
stories.summary: Installed Building Products has acquired Montana-based Take Pride Insulation, adding more than $6 million in annual revenue. The company specializes in spray foam, fiberglass and rockwool insulation. The acquisition strengthens the buyer's presence across residential, multi-family and commercial construction markets in the Mountain West region.

stories.title: China explores waste slurry reduction
stories.summary: China produces over 300 million cubic meters of waste slurry annually, with volumes increasing by 10% each year due to urbanization. Traditional landfill disposal is land-intensive. The nation is now seeking methods to manage this byproduct to meet its carbon peak and neutrality goals.

stories.title: IIT-Madras hosts sustainable energy summit
stories.summary: IIT-Madras organized a summit to discuss India's transition to a sustainable energy future. Sessions covered advanced batteries, hydrogen systems, AI and digitalization. Member of Parliament Praveen Chakravarthy stated that Tamil Nadu is poised to become a strategic hub for energy transition in South Asia.

stories.title: India maintains low profile at climate talks
stories.summary: India is participating in UN climate talks in Turkey with a delegation of 152 people, smaller than those of Bangladesh, Pakistan or Nepal. The country has no dedicated promotional pavilion at the summit. It continues to champion climate funding rights for developing nations behind the scenes.

stories.title: Some employers are starting to help workers buy homes - NewsNation
Mumbai offers property tax rebates for waste management
stories.summary: The BMC announced a property tax incentive of up to 15% for housing societies that process wet waste and adopt water conservation measures. The rebate is subject to verification and compliance with four-way waste segregation rules. The city is enforcing new standards for residential waste.

stories.title: West Suffolk museums receive lighting upgrades
stories.summary: Two museums in West Suffolk have installed energy-efficient LED lighting. The project is expected to deliver annual financial savings of £2,951.17 and reduce carbon emissions by 2.83 tonnes per year. The upgrades were designed to improve exhibit illumination and visitor experience.

stories.title: Germany tests ash for carbon capture
stories.summary: Germany produces 6 million tonnes of waste-incineration ash annually. Researchers from TH Koln and RWTH Aachen University are testing if this residue can absorb and retain carbon dioxide. If successful, the material could be used in road construction and concrete, reducing the need for extracted resources.

stories.title: Phoenix hosts deconstruction and reuse conference
stories.summary: The 2026 Deconstruction and Reuse Conference is taking place in Phoenix this week. The event focuses on saving materials from buildings slated for demolition or renovation. Stardust, a nonprofit that sells donated building materials, is helping to organize the national gathering.

stories.title: Colorado housing sales fall nearly 19 percent in October
stories.summary: Colorado home sales dropped 18.6 percent in October, with pending contracts falling 17.2 percent. The Colorado Association of Realtors reports that affordability challenges and buyer caution have shifted the market toward negotiating opportunities. The market is currently adjusting to a lack of buyer demand.

stories.title: Vermont housing market cools as prices remain high
stories.summary: Vermont officials are discussing property solutions as the state housing market cools. The Vermont Association of Realtors reports a median home price of $425,000, while the Vermont Housing Finance Agency notes prices have risen faster post-pandemic than before. Realtors suggest the market is now leaning toward buyers.

stories.title: Miami home sales drop as borrowing costs weigh on buyers
stories.summary: Miami-Dade home sales fell 10.6 percent in October, with single-family home transactions down 11.8 percent and condo sales down 9.6 percent. Miami Realtors point to higher borrowing costs and uncertainty surrounding the midterms. The condo market continues to struggle following recent safety building legislation.

stories.title: New Orleans home sales rise as median prices fluctuate
stories.summary: New Orleans metro closed sales rose 2.1 percent in October to 1,014, while the median sales price fell 6.4 percent to $266,696. Orleans Parish saw a 16.9 percent price jump, while Jefferson Parish prices fell 15.2 percent. The market remains in a state of local variation.

stories.title: Long Island home sales fall as listings increase - Long Island Business News
McKinney records 190 home sales in October
stories.summary: McKinney reported 190 home sales in October with a median price of $499,450. Homes in the city spent an average of 83 days on the market. The 75071 ZIP code recorded the highest volume of sales for the month.

North Fork real estate transfers and listings
stories.summary: A Greenport Village home is listed for $749,000, featuring three bedrooms and a walk-out basement. Separately, real estate transfer records for September 2026 show a property in Aquebogue sold for $899,999. The market continues to process individual transactions across the North Fork region.
